verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights. Next steps are captured automatically, and summaries can be customized by role, including project managers. Community reports confirm summary emails arrive at the end of meetings, but one hands-on user called the emailed outline "absurd" and "inaccurate", which weakens the "share without editing" bar. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that summaries are accurate enough to share unedited, and detail on the summary structure (e.g., an explicit key-points section).
